title: Ninja Blast Portable Blender, Cordless, 18oz Vessel, Black, BC151BK
features: POWERFUL PORTABLE BLENDING: Blast through frozen ingredients with Ninja Blast portable blending power for perfectly smooth drinks anywhere you go
18-OZ BLENDING CAPACITY: Make up to 18 oz. of your favorite smoothies, protein shakes, and frozen drinks in the same vessel you drink from
PREMIUM COLORS & CARRY: Choose colors that fit your style and take your drink on the go with a comfortable, hinged carry handle
EASY-OPEN SIP LID: Blend and drink in the same BPA-free vessel with a leakproof seal in the locked position for travel-ready confidence
EASY CLEAN & SELF-CLEAN: BPA-free lid and vessel are dishwasher safe, or add water and a drop of dish soap for a 30-second self-clean cycle
RIBBED VESSEL VORTEX: The ribbed vessel creates a vortex while the durable, stainless steel BlastBlade Assembly blasts through ice and frozen ingredients
HASSLE-FREE OPERATION: Separate power and blend buttons help prevent unintentional starts for confident operation on the go
CORDLESS RECHARGEABLE BASE: 7.4V rechargeable base delivers power and speed without a cord and is compatible with USB-C charging for travel-friendly convenience
VERSATILE HOME & TRAVEL USE: Compact design fits into your kitchen routine for smoothies and shakes while also traveling easily for on-the-go blending
WHAT'S INCLUDED: 7.4V Rechargeable Motor Base, Blending Vessel, Sip Lid with Carrying Handle, USB-C Cable, Quick Start Guide, 5-Recipe Inspiration Guide, and Instruction Booklet
